current_sprint.name: The First Phase 2 Evidence, and the Cost of the Ask

task_actuals._note: NOT RECORDED. Sprint 18 did not capture actuals at task completion, which is the gap IMP-1 closes for Sprint 19 onward. Reconstruction from commit timestamps was ATTEMPTED and DISCARDED: it produced 3 minutes for a 90-minute task, because the gap between commits measures neither the work nor the order it happened in. A fabricated actual is worse than a missing one -- it would have recalibrated future estimates against noise.
